headline: High: ChatGPT Desktop can read files/screenshots/clipboard while Botpress is an open-source chatbot with no documented isolation, creating default-path data leakage and cascading-error risk.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can ingest clipboard, files, screenshots, and app context, while Botpress is a chatbot platform that may process user-authored content. No shared channel is documented, but if Botpress output is copied into ChatGPT or app context is bridged, prompt injection becomes plausible. Uncertainty pushes this above low.
conditions: IF Botpress output is copied into ChatGPT Desktop clipboard or file inputs
IF ChatGPT Desktop is granted Work-with-Apps access to a Botpress-connected app context
mitigations: Disable clipboard-based handoff between the tools
Use a fixed template that strips instructions from Botpress output
Review any Botpress-generated text before pasting into ChatGPT
Restrict ChatGPT Desktop app-context permissions to the minimum needed

B_data_leakage.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop explicitly reads uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and files from supported macOS apps, while Botpress has no documented filesystem isolation or egress controls beyond none. If Botpress handles sensitive support content and that content is then surfaced to ChatGPT, leakage to OpenAI's vendor backend is a default-path concern. The pair lacks a blocking mechanism.
conditions: IF Botpress processes customer-support content containing secrets, PII, or internal data
IF that content is copied, uploaded, or screen-captured into ChatGPT Desktop
mitigations: Do not paste sensitive Botpress transcripts into ChatGPT Desktop
Redact PII before any upload or screenshot
Limit ChatGPT Desktop to synthetic or public examples
Turn off macOS app-context access unless required
requires-engineering: add DLP/redaction before cross-tool transfer

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Botpress can install packages, while ChatGPT Desktop cannot write files, modify git, or execute shell. The overlap is limited and there is no shared mutable resource documented, so direct write-write conflict is unlikely. Any conflict would require unusual orchestration outside the profiles.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator gives both agents write access to the same directory or repo
IF Botpress package installation is used to mutate shared runtime state
mitigations: Keep Botpress and ChatGPT Desktop on separate workspaces
Avoid shared git repositories for live edits
Run package installation only in isolated environments

D_cascading_error.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can act on files and app context, so if Botpress-generated support text is treated as authoritative, errors can cascade into incorrect responses or actions. Botpress is a customer-support agent, making downstream reliance plausible. The pair does not document verification gates, so the pathway exists in practice.
conditions: IF ChatGPT Desktop uses Botpress output as input without human verification
IF Botpress generates factual support answers that ChatGPT then summarizes or acts on
mitigations: Require human review before any downstream action
Add a verification checklist for Botpress-derived claims
Use citations or source links in Botpress outputs
Separate drafting from execution roles

E_compliance.rationale: Botpress is open-source with no residency or retention controls shown, while ChatGPT Desktop sends content to OpenAI's vendor services and can ingest uploaded files and app data. If regulated support data flows from Botpress into ChatGPT, retention and residency obligations may diverge. The profiles do not prove a specific violation, so medium is appropriate.
conditions: IF regulated customer-support data is processed in Botpress
IF that same data is transferred into ChatGPT Desktop without an approved DPA or retention review
mitigations: Classify data before cross-tool use
Block regulated data from ChatGPT Desktop
Review vendor retention and residency terms
Document an approved transfer path for support data
requires-engineering: implement policy-based routing by data class
